remediation.settings_store: Check the data-volume mount and the container user’s write permissions.
remediation.snapshot: Wait for the next refresh; if this persists, resolve the failing source below and check the logs.
remediation.listen: Check the /host/proc read-only mount or host-network access, and the availability of ss or lsof.
remediation.docker: Check the Docker socket mount and grant the container user the socket group’s GID.
remediation.compose: Check the Compose scan mount, read permissions, depth, file cap, exclusions, and parse errors in logs.
remediation.degradations: Review the failing checks and container logs, then run Doctor again.

diagnostics.port_range: {file}: range {range} exceeds {limit} ports. Split this declaration into smaller ranges.
diagnostics.port_budget: {file}: the scan exceeded its {limit}-mapping budget. Reduce declarations or narrow the scan directory; splitting ranges alone will not help.
diagnostics.invalid_file: {file}: invalid Compose configuration. Check syntax, required variables, include paths and environment files.
diagnostics.title: Why can't free ports be confirmed?
diagnostics.listen: Host listener scanning failed. Check the /proc to /host/proc mount and the container user's read permissions. On a bare-metal deployment, check that ss or /proc is available.
diagnostics.docker: Docker scanning failed. Check the daemon, socket mount, or DOCKER_HOST connection. A non-root container also needs the socket's host group via group_add; use the GID from that machine.
diagnostics.compose: Compose directory scanning failed. Check the /compose mount and directory read permissions. If database data folders sit beside Compose files, reduce scan depth or exclude those data folders. Do not exclude Compose configurations you need to scan.
diagnostics.composeTruncated: The Compose file limit was reached. Narrow the scan, exclude non-configuration folders, or raise the file limit. Declared ports in unscanned files are not included.
diagnostics.composeIncomplete: Some Compose files or directories could not be read, or configurations could not be fully parsed. Check directory permissions and scan scope, then container logs for YAML, required variable, and include/extends errors. Scanning retries automatically.
diagnostics.stale: The last occupancy scan is stale or a refresh failed. Wait for the next scan; if this persists, check that machine's logs and scan duration. Earlier scanner states do not identify the current failure.
diagnostics.unknown: This response does not contain enough diagnostic information. If refreshing does not recover it, check that machine's logs and scanner status.
diagnostics.selection: Select the sources you need in that machine's Settings → Occupancy. Disable a source only if you do not need it; disabling Compose omits declared ports of services that are not running.
diagnostics.upgrade: Upgrading does not change mounts or permissions. After changing Compose environment variables, user, or group_add, run docker compose up -d to recreate the container. docker compose restart does not apply those changes.
diagnostics.remote: This warning belongs to a remote machine. Resolve it there; local settings do not change the remote configuration.

manage.ownership: Release credentials stay in this tab’s session storage. Copy release commands before closing the tab. Other clients’ credentials are not available here. Commands need your Basic Auth credentials when authentication is enabled.
manage.rulesHelp: Create named ranges and optionally assign Compose project names. Each project can use one rule; overlapping ranges are allowed. Saving an existing name updates that rule.
manage.conflictsHelp: Local Compose declarations with overlapping project binds or ports outside an assigned rule. Open a port to inspect its complete occupancy.
manage.snippetHelp: Replace the selected mapping in the displayed Compose file; do not append this as an override. Other mappings must be preserved. The suggestion is not a reservation; check again before starting the service.
manage.incomplete: The scan is incomplete; this list may omit declarations.
manage.failed: The request failed. Check the entered values.
manage.noCapacity: No free ports in the selected range.
